Subject: Meeting notes + action log — 6/25 MAP checkpoint

Hi all,

Notes from today's 30-min checkpoint (call started 10:30 EDT):
- Attendees: Connor (Redwood), Marissa (Redwood), Tessa (Redwood), Emily (Avery), Tom (Avery)
- Decisions: set primary cutover target = Fri 2026-07-15 02:00-04:00 local (AVH). Canary traffic for 2 hours first; full switch after sanity checks.
- Rollback triggers agreed: >1% error rate OR sustained p50 latency >300ms for 10 minutes OR failed critical acceptance tests.

Meeting action log (owners, dates):
- A1: Connor to create DocuSign envelope for SOW and send to procurement@averyhealth.com — due 2026-06-26 EOD.
- A2: Marissa to complete staging regression and share report — due 2026-07-08.
- A3: Tessa to publish runbook v0.2 with explicit traffic-switch commands and rollback commands (includes CLI commands and runbooks for DB migration quiesce) — due 2026-07-07.
- A4: Emily/Tom to provide final acceptance sign-off name & SSO access verification for test accounts — due 2026-06-30.
- A5: SRE to run load test and post results in shared drive — scheduled 2026-06-25 14:00 EDT (results posted 6/25 evening).

Cutover excerpt (from runbook):
1) Notify on-call and open incident channel (#avh-go-live)
2) Put staging replication into read-only pause (5m)
3) Perform infrastructure pre-checks (health endpoints, KV cache priming)
4) Switch traffic using traffic-switch script (traffic_switch.sh) to route 10% -> 100% over 15 min (canary)
5) Validate acceptance tests (smoke + regression)
6) If failure, run rollback_switch.sh (revert DNS + Redis warm-start) and notify incident channel

Attachments referenced: cutover_runbook_draft.md (I'll push v0.2 by 7/07), prod_traffic_switch_playbook.pdf (TBD final)

If any owner needs more time, flag now — we want no surprises by 7/01.

Thanks,
Tessa Morgan
Program Manager, Customer Launches | Redwood Inference
tessa@redwood.com
